title: [Roadmap]: SGLang Distributed KVCache System For Agentic Workload
body: ### Motivation As agentic workloads drive rapid growth in KV cache storage and transfer volumes, the existing PD disaggregation + HiCache stack is hitting significant bottlenecks. Meanwhile, HiCache's compatibility with hybrid models and other evolving features remains limited. There is an urgent need for a robust, high-performance distributed KV cache system capable of sustaining the heavy demands of large-scale agentic scenarios. The core objective is to achieve end-to-end integration of PD incremental transfer, HiCache / HiSparse, pipeline parallelism, and Eagle — validated at scale on DeepSeek DSA (V32、GLM5) and Linear model (Qwen35) families. ### Roadmap The roadmap below is still incomplete and will be expanded with more content related to Agent/SubAgent KVCache. - [ ] **HiCache: Support Hybrid Model** (Linear & DSA) @hzh0425 - [x] Hybrid Cache Controller & Support Linear Hybrid Model https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/20457 - [x] Mooncake backend support for hybrid model https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/21259 @huangtingwei9988 - [ ] Support MLA + Mamba Hybrid model(KeLing) https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/22957 - [x] 3FS Backend support for hybrid model https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/23241 @kangyifei - [x] HiCache support for Unified Hybrid Radix Cache https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/20415 - [x] Support DeepSeekV4 https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/24691 - [x] Support MiMO-V2 https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/27378 - [ ] Dedup MLA KV cache in host memory across TP ranks https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/26691 - [ ] **PD-Decode Support HiCache** @hzh0425 @huangtingwei9988 - [x] Support Decode Side RadixTree @ishandhanani - [ ] Support Decode Side HybridRadixTree (SWA/Mamba) (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/27770) - [x] Storage Prefetch Interface — Expose a prefetch API that allows newly arriving decode requests to query storage hits and initiate Storage→Host→Device prefetch directly - [ ] Support L2 RadixTree to increase cache hit rate - [ ] Storage supports the concept of groups, enabling unified visibility and eviction for groups composed of multiple keys within a page (e.g., key and value, split by rank, etc.). @huangtingwei9988 - [ ] Heterogeneous TP Support For PD With HiCache @huangtingwei9988 - [ ] **PD Disaggregation**：Idea provided by @ShangmingCai @hzh0425 - [x] **Incremental KV Transfer** — Decode queries storage for cached prefix tokens and reports the hit count to Prefill via protocol extension; Prefill only transfers the non-cached (incremental) portion - [x] **PD Host TransferMode** — Prefill transfers the KV cache directly to Decode's DRAM, bypassing the GPU as an intermediary；Helps increase the decode-side batch size in long-context scenarios. https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/21591 - [ ] **Support for large decode batches:** During decoding, use the L2 and L3 prefix portions cached on the host (hit from prior computations) along with the incremental part transferred from the prefill phase; then load everything back onto the GPU to perform subsequent inference steps. - [ ] **Agent/Rollout KVCache Management** @hzh0425 @stmatengss @ishandhanani - [ ] https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/24656 - [ ] https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/27574 - [ ] **HiCache Compatibility with Other Features** - [ ] PP × HiCache Consistency Fix — Resolve compatibility issues between PP and HiCache by synchronizing Rank 0's cache events across PP ranks via event numbering, ensuring RadixTree state consistency @hzh0425 @whybeyoung https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/22607 - [ ] MTP × HiCache https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/21125 https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30393 - [x] EP & DP × HiCa
